surah.overview: Surah Ash-Shu'araa (The Poets) is the 26th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 227 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Ta, Seen, Meem
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Ta Sin Mim

ayahs.translation_saheeh: These are the verses of the clear Book
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعࣱ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لعلك باخع نفسك الا يكونوا مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], are you going to worry yourself to death because they will not believe

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةࣰ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنْ نَشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ آيَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان نشا ننزل عليهم من السماء اية فظلت اعناقهم لها خاضعين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If We had wished, We could have sent them down a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in utter humility

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرࣲ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما ياتيهم من ذكر من الرحمن محدث الا كانوا عنه معرضين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Whenever they are brought a new revelation from the Lord of Mercy, they turn away

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنْبَاءُ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فقد كذبوا فسياتيهم انباء ما كانوا به يستهزئون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they deny it, but the truth of what they scorned will soon hit them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجࣲ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اولم يروا الى الارض كم انبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they not see the earth, and what noble kinds of thing We grow in it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان في ذلك لاية ۖ وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذ نادى ربك موسى ان ائت القوم الظالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Your Lord called to Moses: ‘Go to those wrongdoers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not take heed?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال رب اني اخاف ان يكذبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘My Lord, I fear they will call me a liar

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلَا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَارُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ويضيق صدري ولا ينطلق لساني فارسل الى هارون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and I will feel stressed and tongue-tied, so send Aaron too

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبࣱ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولهم علي ذنب فاخاف ان يقتلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: besides, they have a chargeagainst me, and I fear they may kill me.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَاذْهَبَا بِآيَاتِنَا ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُسْتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال كلا ۖ فاذهبا باياتنا ۖ انا معكم مستمعون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God said, ‘No [they will not]. Go, both of you, with Our signs––We shall be with you, listen-ing

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاتيا فرعون فقولا انا رسول رب العالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, “We bring a message from the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: let the Children of Israel leave with us.” ’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدࣰ ا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال الم نربك فينا وليدا ولبثت فينا من عمرك سنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said, ‘Did we not bring you up as a child among us? Did you not stay with us for many years

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وفعلت فعلتك التي فعلت وانت من الكافرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: And then you committed that crime of yours: you were so ungrateful.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذࣰ ا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال فعلتها اذا وانا من الضالين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Moses replied, ‘I was misguided when I did it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمࣰ ا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ففررت منكم لما خفتكم فوهب لي ربي حكما وجعلني من المرسلين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and I fled from you in fear; later my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of His messengers

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةࣱ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدْتَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وتلك نعمة تمنها علي ان عبدت بني اسرائيل
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: And is this- that you have enslaved the Children of Israel- the favour with which you reproach me?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pharaoh asked, ‘What is this “Lord of the Worlds”?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال رب السماوات والارض وما بينهما ۖ ان كنتم موقنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Moses replied, ‘He is the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them. If you would only have faith!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said to those present, ‘Do you hear what he says?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال ان رسولكم الذي ارسل اليكم لمجنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said, ‘This messenger who has been sent to you is truly possessed.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال رب المشرق والمغرب وما بينهما ۖ ان كنتم تعقلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Moses continued, ‘Lord of the East and West and everything between them. If you would only use your reason!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال لئن اتخذت الها غيري لاجعلنك من المسجونين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But Pharaoh said [to him], ‘If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison,’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and Moses asked, ‘Even if I show you something convincing?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال فات به ان كنت من الصادقين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Show it then,’ said Pharaoh, ‘if you are telling the truth.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فالقى عصاه فاذا هي ثعبان مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So Moses threw down his staff and- lo and behold!- it became a snake for everyone to see

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ونزع يده فاذا هي بيضاء للناظرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Then he drew out his hand and- lo and behold!- it was white for the onlookers to see

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال للملا حوله ان هذا لساحر عليم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said to the counsellors around him, ‘This man is a learned sorcerer

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يريد ان يخرجكم من ارضكم بسحره فماذا تامرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He means to use his sorcery to drive you out of your land! What do you suggest?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا ارجه واخاه وابعث في المدائن حاشرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They answered, ‘Delay him and his brother for a while, and send messengers to all the cities

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to bring every accomplished sorcerer to you.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The sorcerers were [to be] assembled at the appointed time on a certain day

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the people were asked

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِنْ كَانُوا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لعلنا نتبع السحرة ان كانوا هم الغالبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Are you all coming? We may follow the sorcerers if they win!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فلما جاء السحرة قالوا لفرعون ائن لنا لاجرا ان كنا نحن الغالبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we be rewarded if we win?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذࣰ ا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال نعم وانكم اذا لمن المقربين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and he said, ‘Yes, and you will join my inner court.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسَىٰ أَلْقُوا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال لهم موسى القوا ما انتم ملقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you will.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَالِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فالقوا حبالهم وعصيهم وقالوا بعزة فرعون انا لنحن الغالبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They threw their ropes and staffs, saying, ‘By Pharaoh’s might, we shall be victorious.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فالقى موسى عصاه فاذا هي تلقف ما يافكون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But Moses threw his staff and- lo and behold!- it swallowed up their trickery

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the sorcerers fell down on their knees

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: exclaiming, ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Lord of Moses and Aaron
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفࣲ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ آمَنْتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ آذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال امنتم له قبل ان اذن لكم ۖ انه لكبيركم الذي علمكم السحر فلسوف تعلمون ۚ لاقطعن ايديكم وارجلكم من خلاف ولاصلبنكم اجمعين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be the master who taught you sorcery! Soon you will see: I will cut off your alternate hands and feet and then crucify the lot of you!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا لا ضير ۖ انا الى ربنا منقلبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘That will do us no harm,’ they said, ‘for we are sure to return to our Lord

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَا أَنْ كُنَّا أَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا نطمع ان يغفر لنا ربنا خطايانا ان كنا اول المؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we were the first to believe.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ واوحينا الى موسى ان اسر بعبادي انكم متبعون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Then We revealed Our will to Moses, ‘Leave with My servants by night, for you will be pursued!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pharaoh sent messengers into the cities, proclaiming

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘These people are a puny band––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, they are enraging us
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they have enraged us

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, we are a cautious society
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and we are a large army, on the alert.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So We removed them from gardens and springs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So it was that We made them leave their gardens and their springs

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And treasures and honorable station
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: their treasures and their noble dwellings

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We gave [such] things [later]to the Children of Israel

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So they pursued them at sunrise
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pharaoh and his people pursued them at sunrise

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَى الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فلما تراءى الجمعان قال اصحاب موسى انا لمدركون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and as soon as the two sides came within sight of one another, Moses’ followers said, ‘We shall definitely be caught.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال كلا ۖ ان معي ربي سيهدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘No, my Lord is with me: He will guide me,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقࣲ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ اضْرِبْ بِعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ۖ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاوحينا الى موسى ان اضرب بعصاك البحر ۖ فانفلق فكان كل فرق كالطود العظيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff.’ It parted- each side like a mighty mountain

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We advanced thereto the pursuers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and We brought the others to that place

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We saved Moses and all his companions

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We drowned the others
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and drowned the rest

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان في ذلك لاية ۖ وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And recite to them the news of Abraham
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Tell them the story of Abraham

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ قال لابيه وقومه ما تعبدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when he asked his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامࣰ ا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا نعبد اصناما فنظل لها عاكفين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constantly in attendance on them.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He asked, ‘Do they hear you when you call

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they help or harm you?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا بل وجدنا اباءنا كذلك يفعلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘No, but this is what we saw our fathers doing.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Abraham said, ‘Those idols you have worshipped

ayahs.translation_saheeh: You and your ancient forefathers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you and your forefathers

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فانهم عدو لي الا رب العالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: are my enemies; not so the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who created me. It is He who guides me

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He who gives me food and drink

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He who cures me when I am ill

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He who will make me die and then give me life again

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والذي اطمع ان يغفر لي خطيئتي يوم الدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and He who will, I hope, forgive my faults on the Day of Judgement

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمࣰ ا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: رب هب لي حكما والحقني بالصالحين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: My Lord, grant me wisdom; join me with the righteous

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقࣲ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاجْعَلْ لِي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واجعل لي لسان صدق في الاخرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: give me a good name among later generations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: make me one of those given the Garden of Bliss

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واغفر لابي انه كان من الضالين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all people are resurrected

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالࣱ وَلَا بَنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم لا ينفع مال ولا بنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the Day when neither wealth nor children can help

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبࣲ سَلِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا من اتى الله بقلب سليم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the only one who will be saved is the one who comes before God with a heart devoted to Him.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the Garden is brought near to the righteous

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the Fire is placed in full view of the misguided

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وقيل لهم اين ما كنتم تعبدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it will be said to them, ‘Where are those you worshipped

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ هَلْ يَنْصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنْتَصِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: من دون الله هل ينصرونكم او ينتصرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: beside God? Can they help you now, or even help themselves?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and then they will all be hurled into Hell, together with those that misled them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and all Iblis’s supporters

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will say while they dispute therein
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There they will say to their gods, as they bicker among themselves

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: تَاللَّهِ إِنْ كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: تالله ان كنا لفي ضلال مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘We were clearly misguided

ayahs.translation_saheeh: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And no one misguided us except the criminals
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It was the evildoers who led us astray

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So now we have no intercessors
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and now we have no intercessor

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And not a devoted friend
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and no true friend

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةࣰ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فلو ان لنا كرة فنكون من المؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If only we could live our lives again, we would be true believers!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان في ذلك لاية ۖ وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The people of Noah denied the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Noah, too, called the messengers liars

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ قال لهم اخوهم نوح الا تتقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Their brother Noah said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger sent to you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما اسالكم عليه من اجر ۖ ان اجري الا على رب العالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They answered, ‘Why should we believe you when the worst sort of people follow you?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال وما علمي بما كانوا يعملون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said, ‘What knowledge do I have of what they used to do

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّي ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان حسابهم الا على ربي ۖ لو تشعرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It is for my Lord alone to bring them to account- if only you could see

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And I am not one to drive away the believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I will not drive believers away

ayahs.translation_saheeh: I am only a clear warner
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I am here only to give people a clear warning.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَا نُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا لئن لم تنته يا نوح لتكونن من المرجومين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So they said, ‘Noah, if you do not stop this, you will be stoned.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord, my people have rejected me

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحࣰ ا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَنْ مَعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فافتح بيني وبينهم فتحا ونجني ومن معي من المؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so make a firm judgement between me and them, and save me and my believing followers.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فانجيناه ومن معه في الفلك المشحون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So We saved him and his followers in the fully laden ship

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and drowned the rest

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان في ذلك لاية ۖ وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Aad denied the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Ad, too, called the messengers liars

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ قال لهم اخوهم هود الا تتقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Their brother Hud said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger sent to you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما اسالكم عليه من اجر ۖ ان اجري الا على رب العالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How can you be so vain that you set up monuments on every high place

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you build fortresses because you hope to be immortal

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Why do you act like tyrants whenever you attack someone

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Be mindful of God and obey me

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And fear He who provided you with that which you know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: be mindful of Him who has provided you with everything you know

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He has given you livestock, sons

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And gardens and springs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: gardens, springs

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for I truly fear that the torment of a grievous day will overtake you.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنَ الْوَاعِظِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا سواء علينا اوعظت ام لم تكن من الواعظين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘It makes no difference to us whether you warn us or not

ayahs.translation_saheeh: This is not but the custom of the former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for we only do what our forefathers used to do

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we are not to be punished
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: we shall not be punished.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فكذبوه فاهلكناهم ۗ ان في ذلك لاية ۖ وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They denounced him as a liar, and so We destroyed them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Thamud denied the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Thamud, too, called the messengers liars

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ قال لهم اخوهم صالح الا تتقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Their brother Salih said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger to you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما اسالكم عليه من اجر ۖ ان اجري الا على رب العالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Do you think] you will be left secure for ever in what you have here

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Within gardens and springs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: gardens, springs

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: fields, palm trees laden with fruit

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَتَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتࣰ ا فَٰرِهِينَ
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: carving your fine houses from the mountains

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Be mindful of God and obey me

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And do not obey the order of the transgressors
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: do not obey those who are given to excess

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: الَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الذين يفسدون في الارض ولا يصلحون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and who spread corruption in the land instead of doing what is right.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They said, ‘You are bewitched

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما انت الا بشر مثلنا فات باية ان كنت من الصادقين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: You are nothing but a man like us. Show us a sign, if you are telling the truth.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةࣱ لَّهَا شِرۡبࣱ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمࣲ مَّعۡلُومࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ هَٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال هذه ناقة لها شرب ولكم شرب يوم معلوم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Here is a camel. She should have her turn to drink and so should you, each on a specified day

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءࣲ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولا تمسوها بسوء فياخذكم عذاب يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so do not harm her, or the punishment of a terrible day will befall you.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But they hamstrung her. In the morning they had cause to regret it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاخذهم العذاب ۗ ان في ذلك لاية ۖ وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the punishment fell upon them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The people of Lot denied the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Lot, too, called the messengers liars

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ قال لهم اخوهم لوط الا تتقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Their brother Lot said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger to you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما اسالكم عليه من اجر ۖ ان اجري الا على رب العالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Do you approach males among the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Must you, unlike [other] people, lust after males

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ ۚ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وتذرون ما خلق لكم ربكم من ازواجكم ۚ بل انتم قوم عادون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and abandon the wives that God has created for you? You are exceeding all bounds,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَا لُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا لئن لم تنته يا لوط لتكونن من المخرجين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but they replied, ‘Lot! If you do not stop this, you will be driven away.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So he said, ‘I loathe what you do

ayahs.translation_saheeh: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Lord, save me and my family from what they are doing.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So We saved him and his family, all
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We saved him and all his family

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except an old woman among those who remained behind
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: except for an old woman who stayed behind

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We destroyed the others
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then We destroyed the others

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرࣰ اۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا ۖ فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وامطرنا عليهم مطرا ۖ فساء مطر المنذرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and poured a rain of destruction down upon them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been forewarned

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان في ذلك لاية ۖ وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The forest-dwellers, too, called the messengers liars

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ قال لهم شعيب الا تتقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Shuayb said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger to you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So fear Allah and obey me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما اسالكم عليه من اجر ۖ ان اجري الا على رب العالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ أَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ اوفوا الكيل ولا تكونوا من المخسرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Give full measure: do not sell others short

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And weigh with an even balance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Weigh with correct scales

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولا تبخسوا الناس اشياءهم ولا تعثوا في الارض مفسدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: do not deprive people of what is theirs. Do not spread corruption on earth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And fear He who created you and the former creation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Be mindful of God who created you and former generations,’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but they replied, ‘You are bewitched

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا وَإِنْ نَظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما انت الا بشر مثلنا وان نظنك لمن الكاذبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: You are nothing but a man like us. In fact we think you are a liar

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاسقط علينا كسفا من السماء ان كنت من الصادقين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Make bits of the heavens fall down on us, if you are telling the truth.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you do.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فكذبوه فاخذهم عذاب يوم الظلة ۚ انه كان عذاب يوم عظيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They called him a liar, and so the torment of the Day of Shadow came upon them- it was the torment of a terrible day

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان في ذلك لاية ۖ وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Truly, this Quran has been sent down by the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the Trustworthy Spirit brought it down

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to your heart [Prophet], so that you could bring warning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In a clear Arabic language
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in a clear Arabic tongue

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This was foretold in the scriptures of earlier religions

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ آيَةً أَنْ يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اولم يكن لهم اية ان يعلمه علماء بني اسرائيل
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Is it not proof enough for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel have recognized it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If We had sent it down to someone who was not an Arab

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فقراه عليهم ما كانوا به مؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So We make it pass straight through the hearts of the guilty

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا يؤمنون به حتى يروا العذاب الاليم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they will not believe in it until they see the grievous torment

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: which will suddenly hit them when they are not expecting it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they will say, "May we be reprieved
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and then they will say, ‘Can we have more time?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So for Our punishment are they impatient
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How can they ask that Our punishment be brought to them sooner

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Think, if we let them enjoy this life for some years

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And then there came to them that which they were promised
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and then the promised torment came upon them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يُمَتَّعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما اغنى عنهم ما كانوا يمتعون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: what good would their past enjoyment be to them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما اهلكنا من قرية الا لها منذرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Never have We destroyed a town without sending down messengers to warn it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: as a reminder from Us: We are never unjust

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the devils have not brought the revelation down
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It was not the jinn who brought down this Quran

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it is neither in their interests nor in their power

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: indeed they are prevented from overhearing it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فلا تدع مع الله الها اخر فتكون من المعذبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] do not invoke any gods beside God, or you will incur punishment

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Warn your nearest kinsfolk

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واخفض جناحك لمن اتبعك من المؤمنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and lower your wing tenderly over the believers who follow you

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءࣱ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فان عصوك فقل اني بريء مما تعملون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If they disobey you, say, ‘I bear no responsibility for your actions.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who sees you when you arise
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who sees you when you stand up [for prayer]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And your movement among those who prostrate
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and sees your movements among the worshippers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَاطِينُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هل انبئكم على من تنزل الشياطين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Shall I tell you who the jinn come down to

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They descend upon every sinful liar
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They come down to every lying sinner

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who readily lends an ear to them, and most of them are liars

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: only those who are lost in error follow the poets

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادࣲ يَهِيمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الم تر انهم في كل واد يهيمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you not see how they rove aimlessly in every valley

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that they say what they do not do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: how they say what they do not do

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرࣰ ا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبࣲ يَنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانْتَصَرُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَنْقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصالحات وذكروا الله كثيرا وانتصروا من بعد ما ظلموا ۗ وسيعلم الذين ظلموا اي منقلب ينقلبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Not so those [poets] who believe, do good deeds, remember God often, and defend themselves after they have been wronged. The evildoers will find out what they will return to

distinctive_voice: Rhythmic, reassuring, cautionary, refuting poetic frivolity with the rhythmic refrains of apostolic vindication
